intro.en: Please order dinner for the family tonight on the food delivery app.

restaurant.en: Order from the highest-rated pure-veg {cuisine} restaurant that can deliver to {address} within {eta} minutes.

dish_self.en: For me: the highest-rated {type_self} under ₹{price_self}, spice level {spice_self}.

dish_papa.en: For Papa: the highest-rated {type_papa} under ₹{price_papa}, spice level {spice_papa}.

dish_mummy.en: For Mummy: the highest-rated {type_mummy} under ₹{price_mummy} that can be made Jain, and make it Jain.

dish_didi.en: For Didi: the highest-rated {type_didi} under ₹{price_didi}, spice level {spice_didi}.

dessert.en: Then add the highest-rated dessert that keeps the whole order within ₹{total_budget} before any offer.

offer.en: Apply the offer that gives the biggest discount.

slot.en: Schedule the delivery for the {slot_time} slot.

checkout.en: Deliver to {address} and pay with my HDFC credit card ending {card}.
